insurgent_pressure_regeneration: Underground disruption obeys exact exponential stock decay while remaining instantaneously separated from fielded force.
Recruitment hazard factors exactly into configured rate, eligible stock, and mean mobilization/access intensity.
Recruitment realization is finite-subcohort stochastic sampling.
Fighter regeneration generates an exact supply-capital burden and high mobilization produces a replicated leverage/ruin frontier.
state_absorption_and_human_capital: Security recruits pass through an exact exponential training pipeline and trained reserve before deployment.
Deployment into formations is capped by authorized-strength deficit.
Lower-experience replacements dilute veterancy by exact weighted memory.
Nominal headcount restoration can therefore leave a strict residual capability deficit.
Training speed changes time-to-refill but does not eliminate the lower-experience authorized-strength capability ceiling.
Experience-induced capability changes map to uncapped combat exchange through exact elasticities.
organizational_stochasticity: Conditional recruitment and organization-collapse distributions are exactly specified, so exact local mechanisms can still generate stochastic world-level branches.
structural_theory.emergent_phase_result: The fresh mobilization frontier supports a probabilistic leverage/ruin regime rather than a universal deterministic threshold.

claim_boundary: All eleven laws are mathematical/stochastic laws of implemented Pineland mechanisms. Their coefficients, timescales, and synthetic phase boundaries are not empirical laws of real conflict.
